### Batch 10 — local bad baseline, all genes frozen, 1000 episodes, 10 reused seeds × 3 species, probe

```
92555035 357697139 477670760 554097749 588057067
1036090771 1094375482 1479639638 1633811275 1809987412
```

MacBook Air M4, CPU only, up to six simultaneous simulations, one thread per simulation. Five-minute work / two-minute rest cycles, with additional pauses whenever macOS thermal state is above nominal. `genome.evolve=[]`; founders and descendants carry the fixed bad-baseline gene means.

## Hardware

- **Local smoke tests / small runs:** MacBook, CPU only, `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1`.
- **Direction-1 baseline (Batch 1, 40000-episode full runs):** rented Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS box, kernel 6.8.0-138-generic, x86_64, 16 vCPU visible / 61 GiB RAM / 338 GB disk, no GPU. One simulation at a time (sequential), per owner's own benchmark.
- **Bad-baseline probe batches (2–6):** rented Ubuntu 24.04 LTS boxes, CPU only, no GPU, 12–16 vCPU depending on the specific rental, one thread per process (`OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1`), parallel up to core count.

- **Batch 7–9:** server `62.238.127.235`, Ubuntu, AMD EPYC-Milan (virtual), 16 vCPU / 8 virtual cores with SMT, 61 GiB RAM, 338 GB disk; CPU only, one thread per process, up to 16 processes.
